notes.content:
Dear Raven community,

just a quick update on a MAC issue has been deployed.

Patch-Notes: 
- Fixed a problem on certain Retina-display Mac systems via a new windowed mode

Cheers

notes.title: Patch released!
notes.content:
Thanks for all the kind words, we're thrilled that players are enjoying the new and improved version of our classic whodunit tale!

We went through your feedback and fixed a couple of hiccups (details below).

Patch Notes: 
- Fixed a crash-issue at startup on MacOS 
- Fixed problems with Steam Cloud save games
- Fixed missing unlock of certain Steam Achievements
- Fixed settings-problem that caused wrong resolution to be displayed

notes.title: The Raven Remastered is now available!
notes.content:
Vienna/Austria, Bremen/Germany, March 13th, 2018; The Raven – Legacy of a Master Thief, the classic whodunit adventure by KING Art, has been fully remastered and is now available on Steam. The game goes by the name of The Raven Remastered and does not only feature fully remastered animations, lighting and hair in full HD resolution, but also subtitles in French, Spanish and Simplified Chinese for the first time (already available in German, Russian, Polish and Italian). 

Release-Trailer on YouTube: https://youtu.be/nk32FQ0O-2g

Good news for owners of the original The Raven - Legacy of a Master Thief
Everyone who owns the original version of The Raven on Steam will get the new The Raven Remastered free of charge. The game should have already appeared in the owners' libraries. Owners of the Deluxe Edition should now also have the updated Deluxe Edition Extras for The Raven Remastered.

Check it out:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/736810/ 

Cheers & stay tuned
Your THQ Nordic Team

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - The Raven Remastered, 25% off!
notes.content:
The Raven Remastered is Now Available on Steam and is 25% off!*

London, 1964. An ancient ruby is stolen from the British Museum. At the crime scene: a raven feather. Is somebody trying to follow in the footsteps of The Raven, the legendary master thief who disappeared years before?
